source: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, every outcome with an analysis and a plain one-row table, fetched 2026-10-27 by analyses.py fetch-arms
rule: two-arm 95% two-sided CI of a difference, arms of at least 10: half-width within 0.75 to 1.33 of 1.96 sqrt(s1^2/n1 + s2^2/n2) fits SD; of 1.96 sqrt(s1^2 + s2^2) fits SE

spike_sd_labelled.meaning: SD-labelled analyses binned by log2 of CI half-width over the SE prediction

spike_se_labelled.meaning: SE-labelled analyses binned by log2 of CI half-width over the SD prediction
